name: ai-forecast
title: AI Forecast
description: Weekly and Session quota forecasts, learned usage pace and quiet alerts from local OpenUsage data.
author: Thomasevano

commands.name: forecast
commands.title: AI Forecast
commands.description: Check Claude and Codex forecasts, allowance per day or hour, and your learned usage pace.

commands.name: monitor
commands.title: Monitor AI Quotas
commands.description: Sample local quotas and notify only on sustained risk or exhaustion when monitoring is enabled.

preferences.name: pythonPath
preferences.title: Python executable override
preferences.description: Optional trusted executable. Leave blank to detect installed Python 3 automatically. Python 3.12 or newer is recommended.

preferences.name: openusagePath
preferences.title: OpenUsage helper override
preferences.description: Optional trusted executable. Leave blank to detect the installed OpenUsage CLI. Without a CLI, compatible 0.7.x releases use the local HTTP API.

preferences.name: showOutlook
preferences.title: Community reset signals
preferences.label: Show codex-reset.com and willcodexquotareset.com when checking a Codex forecast
preferences.description: External probabilities and signal scores are shown separately, never included in allowance or alerts. No quota data is uploaded.

scripts.test: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v && node --test tests/test-outlooks.mjs
